title: SecOps-NG CRA Reporting-Clock Kind
description: Identifies which CRA Article 14 reporting clock the vulnerability-intake case has started. Promoted out of the F-WF-01 `__cra_clock__` mirror field (which declared the two kinds in prose only on the assess-CRA-reporting-trigger step) so the vulns evidence stream and the four CRA-timing KPIs (`kpi.cra_early_warning_on_time@v1`, `kpi.cra_notification_72h_on_time@v1`, `kpi.cra_final_report_on_time@v1`, `kpi.cra_severe_incident_on_time@v1`) read one canonical enum. `none` is the explicit no-clock state — recording it is required so a replay can distinguish 'clock was assessed and found not to apply' from 'assessment step did not fire'.

x_clock_definitions.none: Triage assessed the case and found no CRA Article 14 clock applies (no actively-exploited indicator, no severe incident on a product with digital elements within scope).
x_clock_definitions.article_14_1: CRA Article 14(1) clock started: an actively-exploited vulnerability in a product with digital elements. Drives the 24h early-warning, 72h incident-notification, and 14d final-report milestones.
x_clock_definitions.article_14_3: CRA Article 14(3) clock started: a severe incident impacting the security of a product with digital elements. Drives the 24h severe-incident-notification milestone.
